import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))
from tools import benchmark_mimo2_cache as bench
bench.QUESTIONS=[x for x in bench.QUESTIONS if x[0]=='ru']
assert len(bench.QUESTIONS)==1
sys.argv=['recheck-scatter-ru','--build','build-local/mimo2-cuda','--cuda-bin','build-local/cuda-13.0/bin/x64',
'--model','H:/models/mimo-v2.6-flash/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL-GSQ-RCO-3.5bit.gguf','--axis','d2d',
'--fixed-pack-guards','1','--fixed-slab-mib','16','--expert-cache-mib','11264','--warmups','2','--repeats','3',
'--order','0,2,2,0','--output-dir','build-local/mimo2-validation/scatter-ru-abba']
raise SystemExit(bench.main())
